features.title: Create a chat design ui only with nativetailwind
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can click New Chat and see a fresh empty conversation.
verification: Verify a new conversation appears in the sidebar.
Verify the main panel shows an empty conversation state.
evidence: web export and runtime verified — chat list and chat screen both render
iOS export and simulator verified — both screens render correctly
features.notes: UI-only implementation with in-memory state via React context. Conversation list at / with + New Chat button; chat screen at /chat/[id] with empty state and disabled input.

features.title: Send a message in the current conversation
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can submit a message and see it appear in the active thread.
verification: Type a message into the input.
Verify the new message appears in the thread.
evidence: iOS export and simulator verified — chat screen renders with editable input and Send button
features.notes: User messages stored in ChatContext. Input wired to sendMessage which appends to messages array and updates conversation title. Messages render as right-aligned blue bubbles in a FlatList with auto-scroll.

features.title: LLM should respond to the user message
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can see LLM response in the active thread
verification: Type a message into the input.
Verify the LLM response appears in the thread.
evidence: iOS export and simulator verified — chat screen renders with input and Send button
refactored to use Expo API route (llm-004 through llm-006)
features.notes: LLM responses routed through Expo API route at /api/chat. API key stays server-side.

features.title: Fix app.json for server output
features.user_visible_behavior: No visible change. Enables Expo API routes.
verification: app.json has a single 'web' key with 'output': 'server'.
Existing chat UI still renders on web, iOS, and Android.
evidence: merged duplicate web keys into one with output: server
web, iOS, and android exports verified
features.notes: Duplicate web keys merged. Output changed from static to server.

features.title: Create Expo API route for chat completions
features.user_visible_behavior: POST /api/chat returns an LLM response. API key stays server-side.
verification: POST /api/chat with a messages array returns an assistant response.
process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY is only read in the +api.ts file.
curl http://localhost:8081/api/chat returns a valid response.
evidence: web export shows API route bundled separately: /api/chat (4.9KB)
curl test confirmed route receives and forwards requests (401 from expired key, not code issue)
no OPENAI_API_KEY reference in client code
features.notes: System prompt, model config, and OpenAI fetch logic in +api.ts file. API key via process.env server-side only.

features.title: Wire chat context to use API route and remove old client
features.user_visible_behavior: Chat works the same as before — user sends message, LLM responds.
verification: chat-context.tsx calls fetch('/api/chat') instead of importing getCompletion.
No OPENAI_API_KEY reference exists outside of +api.ts files.
Chat UI still renders on iOS and Android.
features.notes: sendMessage in chat-context.tsx POSTs to /api/chat. Old client-side OpenAI module removed.

features.title: Properly display the LLM markdown response in the chat ui with react-native-markdown-display
features.user_visible_behavior: The LLM response should be properly displayed as per the markdown syntax
verification: The llm reponse should be properly displayed in chat ui
evidence: iOS export verified — chat screen renders without crash
needs manual test: send a message and verify markdown renders in LLM response
features.notes: Assistant messages rendered with react-native-markdown-display (already installed). User messages stay as plain Text. Styles cover headings, lists, bold/italic, inline code, and code blocks.

features.title: Stream LLM response to the ui
features.user_visible_behavior: User should see the llm response coming in stream
verification: User should see messages coming in stream
evidence: needs manual test: send a message and verify response streams in progressively
features.notes: API route forwards SSE stream from OpenAI. Chat context reads stream with ReadableStream reader, parses SSE events, and updates assistant message text progressively. Empty assistant bubble appears immediately on send.

features.title: Update the chat UI, to replace send with a stop button
features.user_visible_behavior: User should see stop button instead of send when llm repsonse stream is not finished
verification: User sees stop button instead of send
After, the llm response streaming is complete, restores send button hiding stop button
evidence: needs manual test: verify stop button appears during streaming and reverts to send after
features.notes: Send button swaps to red Stop button when isStreaming is true. Reverts when streaming completes or is aborted.

features.title: Stop LLM response when stop button is clicked
features.user_visible_behavior: User should be able to stop the llm response
verification: llm streaming is stopped and chat ui is restored
evidence: needs manual test: verify stop button aborts the stream and restores send button
features.notes: AbortController stored in ref. stopStreaming aborts the fetch and resets isStreaming. Partial text from the stream is preserved in the message.

features.title: Remove LLM chat bubble from UI if the message is empty and isStreaming is false
features.user_visible_behavior: User should not see empty llm empty chat bubble when he aborts the request
verification: User should not see empty chat bubble
evidence: needs manual test: send a message, abort before content arrives, verify empty bubble is removed
features.notes: In sendMessage finally block, filter out the assistant message if its text is still empty. Handles abort-before-content and stream-ends-without-content cases. Messages with partial content are preserved.
